name: Copilot Managed Runtime
desc: Managed hosting for apps built in Cowork, Code and Copilot Studio.
desc_zh: 为 Cowork、Code 和 Copilot Studio 里做出来的应用提供托管。
solves: An app nobody owns becomes a security problem. Managed Runtime keeps it inside the Microsoft 365 environment, governed by IT and visible in the admin center.
solves_zh: 没人认领的应用迟早变成安全问题。Managed Runtime 把它留在 Microsoft 365 环境内，由 IT 管控并在管理后台可见。
best_for: Your team has built apps in Copilot and IT has not signed off on where they run.
best_for_zh: 你的团队已经在 Copilot 里做了应用，而 IT 还没批准它们跑在哪里。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft blog, https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/09/25/introducing-the-）。 Preview from 2026-09-25; general availability announced 2026-11-17. Also the foundation for Copilot Studio apps and is being opened to third-party and pro-code developers. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：2026-09-25 只是发布预告，随后是限量预览；公众首次可用日是正式发布日。Ignite 2026 文章原话：「Copilot Managed Runtime for securely hosting and managing apps is now generally available」。分类从辅助工具改为智能体平台。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/11/17/copilot-at-microsoft-ignite-expanding-whats-possible-with-intelligence-built-for-work/
